issues.extracted: Local Sources split into 10 items (property 2,146,799, carline 15,183, licenses 1,500, donations 116,130, lunch 29,280, activity receipts 66,680, etc.); State Sources split into 8 items
issues.on_page: Exhibit D prints only broad groups: Local Sources 2,658,140, County 30,887, State 2,464,977, Federal 698,629, Other 35,543
issues.issue: The split uses the per-fund budget schedules (Exhibits F-L), whose subtotals tie to the Exhibit D fund columns, plus Exhibit B for property, PPD, motor vehicle and interest. The arithmetic holds: Local 2,658,140, County 30,887, State 2,464,977, Federal 698,629 and Other 35,543 all re-add, and the total is 5,888,176. But carline, licenses, donations, lunch sales and activity receipts are not printed as Total-column lines anywhere. They are sums across fund schedules, which is a reasonable reading of 'the report prints the breakdown', but it is still a judgment call.

This matches Exhibit D, which puts all Special Building spending (280,663) under Operation & Maintenance of Plant. Building improvements could also be read as capital outlay, so it is a judgment call.
